verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents per-agent permission configs (allow, ask, or deny for tool actions) and read-only agents. Those are adjacent tool-gating controls, not issuable scoped API credentials. Nothing in the pack shows OpenCode minting least-privilege keys or tokens for an agent; provider API keys are user-supplied, and the server mode exposes an OpenAPI endpoint with no documented credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
